patterns.note: A single, vibrant red (#ff4338) is used as the primary accent color, providing strong visual anchors for branding, interactive elements, and key highlights against a predominantly white and black interface.
Generous use of white space creates an airy and minimalist aesthetic, particularly in the hero and introductory sections, allowing content blocks to breathe and stand out.

The initial hero element, a large red rectangle with text, dynamically transforms and shrinks into a smaller, fixed text element as the user scrolls, eventually disappearing to reveal the main page content.
Content sections, including image cards and text blocks, are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, staggered appearance.
A consistent, clean sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with clear hierarchy established through varying weights and sizes, often employing uppercase for labels and subheadings to add emphasis.

technique_notes: The initial hero features a large, full-width colored block with centered text that dynamically scales down and transforms into a smaller, fixed text element in the viewport as the user scrolls, eventually fading out to reveal the main page content.

Sections and individual content elements, such as images and text blocks, are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a staggered appearance effect, consistent with an 'Animate On Scroll' library (aos).
A minimalist header containing the logo and a hamburger menu remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent navigation access without distracting from the content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced and legible; headings are distinct but not overly dominant, body text is clear, and uppercase labels are used for emphasis.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and initial content sections, transitioning to a more balanced density in the project grids and footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a single, bold red accent color against a stark white background creates a powerful, minimalist brand identity. The dynamic, transforming hero element that shrinks and reveals content upon scroll is a unique and engaging entry point, setting a sophisticated tone for an architecture and design studio.
